narrative.headline: Smart money is rotating into Computer Hardware and select Semiconductors while explicitly fading the Semiconductor Equipment complex.
bullish_themes: Computer Hardware storage/server names dominate ask-side flow (STX, SMCI, WDC, DELL, SNDK) — suggests AI infrastructure buildout thesis is being repositioned downstream from chips to boxes and storage
Semiconductor Equipment bifurcation: smaller/mid names (AMKR, TER, ENTG) see clean bullish flow while the big three (AMAT, LRCX, KLAC) get sold — capex concentration story narrowing
Mega-cap semis (QCOM, AVGO, MRVL) attracting size, but NVDA/AMD/MU only lean bullish — leadership broadening away from the obvious AI trade
Quantum/exotic compute split: QBTS gets aggressive ask-side accumulation (100% bullish) while IONQ and RGTI see heavy bearish flow — pair-trade signature
notable_individual_flows: AMKR: 98.5% bullish across 28 ask-side prints — cleanest signal in the scan
STX: $8.3M premium at 95.6% bullish, 24 ask-side prints — high-conviction storage bet
QCOM: $16.4M premium, 85% bullish, 38 ask-side prints — size and conviction aligned on a non-AI semi
MPWR: 100% bearish on $3.45M — analog power management explicitly faded
KLAC: 79% bearish on $5M — clearest short signal in equipment names
narrative.absences: No bullish flow outside XLK despite a 30-name scan — software, consumer, financials, healthcare all silent today. The entire conviction set is concentrated in one sector, which is a concentration risk for the drilldown.
